title: What the Well Gave Back

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Ask a well for a house-name and it gives you the weather. The question goes on toward the bridge; the answer stays in the bucket.
epigraph.attribution: A proverb of the Clay Yard wells

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and seventeen to four hundred and nineteen days, six months and two hundred and thirty-seven to two hundred and thirty-nine days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 416 exact at the opening on answer 408, closing at 419 exact on answer 414. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting, and the yard well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Ilmen 23, 24 and 25 are ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes; no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner on any of them, and Ilmen 30 (Day 424), the month's third and last reading and market, stands five mornings beyond the close, a date and not a day earned. The chapter opens in the small hours of Ilmen 23 with the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 408 and the count exact at 416, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, two readings of the year gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind the twelve of Y.H. 813 and two still two and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, the fifth shaping on its own tray, the clerk's entered figure on its own place with a finger between it and Tarn's degree and another between it and the face at the yard's edge, the second man's narrow slate with its writing turned to the sleeve and his direction down the north bridge road on their own places, Tarn's withheld sentence found where put and not made a habit, the softening at the river's skin kept as weather, six hearings of the full note with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth. Its one meaningful change is the well-asking advanced and NOT paid (T102): a word comes up once at the yard well that the second man with the slate under his arm asked after a house-name under this roof and was answered with the weather, filed on a place of its own beside the direction and the slate, the first man's face, the clerk's entered figure and the fifth shaping, with a finger between every pair — a report with no body under it, no name, owner, answer carried, witness, sale, tenth hand or rule, expressly not the calling of the loan, not a second sighting and not joined to Tarn's valuable ear or Jorra's ungiven promise.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Asking at the Well
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{417}{Ilmen 23, Y.H. 814, Thirdday}: small hours opening on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 408 and the count exact at 416, then first light, the carrying-down and the morning work at the yard well. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Ilva once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, her hand to her sleeve and the notched strip unread, her ninth record-first hand nine and expressly NOT the speaker of any word that comes up; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons at the bucket-round, among them the unnamed neighbour who brings the word. No Berr, Hessa sighting, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; the first man from Slate Row's face, the second man's direction and slate, the clerk's entered figure and the fifth shaping stay on their own places; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eleventh arithmetic or eighth opening and no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 20's reading or Ilmen 21's passing crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 30 stands five mornings off, a date and not a day earned. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Count becomes 417 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-seven days told by nobody, and is not stood up as a threshold, doctrine or figure; the twelve old arithmetics are not laid across the two readings of the year, for paper is not a payer and no key lies in his hand (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047). Sella keeps the whole morning grammar — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, intake/hold/letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between staple and wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven walked-around places once and not twice, fold righted without a second fold, widow's mark untouched because a morning, a well, a yard and a basket are not openings (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person and takes his bent finger from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T036/T076, T062/T035/T031 held). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid: word comes up once at the well, from mouth to mouth with no body standing under it, that the second man with the narrow slate asked after a house-name under this roof and was answered with the weather; nobody saw the asking, no voice carried, no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure brought under a roof, no room entered and no name spoken. The boy takes the word apart by the order of its parts — the asking, the name asked after, the weather that answered, the half-beat where an answer would have stood — and files the ASKING on a place of its own beside the second man's direction and slate, the first man's face, the clerk's entered figure and the fifth shaping, with a finger between every pair (T102 advanced, not paid). He gives it no name, owner, answer carried, interior, witness, sale, tenth hand and no joining to Tarn's valuable ear, Tarn's ended term, Jorra's ungiven promise, the clerk's inward slate, the fifth shaping or the calling of the loan that can hear. It is a shape gathering interest toward the far-off calling and the far-off hand, not the calling, not a second sighting of the man, not a sixth shaping and not a rule; the direction is not repeated and Ilva is expressly not made the speaker or a reader by the word at her well (T080/T090). Answer 409 filed on the sixth place: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-third Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 23 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 410 and the count at 417 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-seven days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine. Walk-ons at the ordinary Thirdday grammar. The second man is not on stage, his direction and slate stay where put and are not repeated, the asking is not told a second time on a day that earned only its twenty-third, no collector comes up or down the clay road, and no sixth of anything stands. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather — pail on stone, rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, a loaf pushed a finger's width and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure, barley passed wall to wall and never made into a number — and goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, keeping the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). At the Vail corner the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash where no broom has gone in two years, the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge with a finger between; the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note runs nearer under the skin, found where put and called weather, not looked twice, not made a sign, a fourth covering or a payment (T083/T085/T092, T009/T013/T092 held, advanced and not paid). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a number in a shut fist goes toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve; a woman sent to ask what a pot cost gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and the figure read over it does not know its cost, with no signature between figure and price (T077). The asking, the direction, the slate, the first man's face, the clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the fifth shaping stay on separate places with a finger between every pair; no witness, reader, sale, tenth hand or paying stands under any of them and the asking is not joined to Tarn's ear or Jorra's promise (T102/T080/T090 advanced, not paid). At the going of the light Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar with repair kept apart from restoration — twice-mended pot thumb-first, hairline showing between staple and wire, both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven places once and not twice, fold righted without a second fold, widow's mark hanging where it hangs and no eighth opening due (T058/T079/T100). Small hours: the towel comes out and he goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap — six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's gap, the boards' four and four and a thumb-width knot, or the two readings behind one unsigned figure beside the twelve old ones, three counts in three places staying three; four rooms with the same gap and no Court room a fifth likeness; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the carried fire's four pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and seventeen days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the fire and the man standing side by side without becoming one; the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T078, T061/T082, T081, T088, T060/T086/T097). Answer 410 filed; the hand goes up the inch toward the river's note, the inch not a reach, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lies flat against the fold.

scenes.title: The Twenty-fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{418}{Ilmen 24, Y.H. 814, Fourthday}: small hours opening on the hand laid down on answer 410 and the count exact at 417, first light, and the morning work, with answer 411 and the count reaching 418 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-eight days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary Fourthday grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no telling at the well, no repetition of the asking or the second man's direction, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 23 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and Ilmen 30 stands six mornings off and is not brought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust hardened into old horn past the point where a child would still eat it, fold found where put and still a finding, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086). Count becomes 418 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-eight days, told by nobody; he does not stand it up as a threshold and does not lay the twelve old arithmetics or the two readings of the year across one another to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 held). Sella keeps the whole morning grammar with the widow's mark untouched — a morning, a shelf, a yard and a basket are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth comes due on a day that earned only its twenty-fourth (T058/T079/T100). Tarn at the kindling keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife on its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; the sentence is found where put, not made a habit and not a tenth stopping, and the silence is not repeated on an unearned day; the Seed 16 breath stays unspent and the loan uncalled at the very end of a term already ended (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra's meal-fine grey dust, the wheel spoken to before any person, the pot told *You'll do* with its full note withheld, the damper's two bites and the promise neither given nor withdrawn hold; *he's not Vail* stays sealed (T062/T035/T031 held). The asking from the well stays on its own place beside the direction and the slate; no second asking comes and the question is not made a custom, a witness or a door (T102 held, advanced and not paid). Answer 411 filed on the sixth place. Exact last image: the hand outside the wool laid flat against the fold on answer 411, the asking kept where put with no second telling.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-fourth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 24 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 412 and the count at 418 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-eight days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her count still in wood. Walk-ons at the ordinary Fourthday grammar. The second man is not on stage, the asking is not repeated, no word comes up at the well a second time, no collector comes up or down the road, and no sixth of anything stands. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: afternoon small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place; the trough bare and dark with the gone pan's shallow round print on a place of its own, not laid across the loaf's stopping or the ridge; the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw kept beside the called-gone grey with a finger between, and a thing left in place not a thing forgiven (T098, T009/T013/T092). The softening at the river's skin — air less cold off the river, the thinned Ash tang, the grey lying a hair less distinct along one stretch, the skin softer at one edge where the low note runs nearer under it — is found where put and called weather, not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a payment and not made again, and he does not look twice, for looking twice is how a finding becomes a habit (T083/T085/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather: the fist goes toward the well, looks at the light and returns into the sleeve and arrives nowhere; the woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and no signature stands between the figure and the price (T077). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge, the first man's face, the second man's slate and direction, and the asking from the well stay on separate places with a finger between every pair; no joining, witness, reader, sale, tenth hand or paying stands under any of them and the asking is not made the calling of the loan (T102/T080/T090 advanced, not paid). At the going of the light Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar with the pot's hairline left showing, both proverbs to pot and fire, the grain unfigured, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, the nineteen steps at the half-pace and the fold righted without a second fold; Tarn's sentence is found where put and not made a habit or a tenth stopping and Jorra's bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and comes out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, for a second would be a habit and a third a way and both want a payer where none stood (T058/T079/T100, T036/T076, T062/T035/T031). Small hours: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told with both gaps in their own squares; the carried fire's four pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and eighteen days and Garl's name unspoken the same number; nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the keeping at the fold found where put (T078, T061/T082, T088, T080/T090, T060/T086/T097). Answer 412 filed; the hand goes up the inch, holds the interval whole on the river's note under its covering, lets it go on the note's own finishing — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lies flat against the fold.

scenes.title: The Twenty-fifth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{419}{Ilmen 25, Y.H. 814, Fifthday}: small hours opening on the hand laid down on answer 412 and the count exact at 418, first light, and the morning work, with answer 413 and the count reaching 419 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-nine days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary Fifthday grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no telling at the well, no repetition of the asking or the direction, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 24 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and Ilmen 30 stands five mornings off and is not brought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order, the crust stiff and brown-edged and gone into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put and still a finding and not a placing, the thread frozen and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). Count becomes 419 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-nine days, told by nobody who would have known what a number counted; he does not stand the number up as a threshold or a figure and borrows no payer from the arithmetics gone up the road, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 held). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket and keeps the whole morning grammar — coals told the thaw and turned with the broken pot's back, neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven walked-around places once and not twice, fold righted without a second fold — and the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, for a morning, a hearth, a shelf and a basket are not openings and no eighth came due (T058/T079/T100). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person and takes his finger from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 again (T036/T076, T062/T035/T031 held). The asking stays on its own place with a finger between it and the direction, the slate, the face, the clerk's figure and the fifth shaping; no second asking comes and no answer is carried under any roof (T102 held). Answer 413 filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air; the hand goes down flat on the fold.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-fifth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 25 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 414 and the count at 419 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-nine days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at kindling and flagstones with the sentence held where put and the loan uncalled; Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper with the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's slate unread up the road with her eighth hand eighth; Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the two readings of the year inside; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and entered figure reported at the out-of-line landing; the first man from Slate Row's face and the second man's narrow slate with its writing turned to the sleeve and his direction down the north bridge road on their own places; the well-asking answered with the weather on its own place beside them; the fifth shaping on its own tray; the softening at the river's skin kept as weather; the green at the pot board and the shape at the market's edge as sightings with no eighth. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second well-telling, no market, no collector, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: afternoon small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place; costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry; through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water under its winter skin, softer at one edge where the low note ran nearer, found where put and not made a sign, a fourth covering or a payment on a tend-day that earned only its twenty-fifth (T098, T009/T013/T092, T077, T083/T085/T092). At the going of the light Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar with repair kept apart from restoration — the twice-mended pot's hairline showing between staple and wire, both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, the grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, the nineteen steps at the half-pace, the fold righted at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and no second fold — and the widow's mark hangs where it hangs and no eighth opening comes due (T058/T079/T100). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, rough from the wash and smelling of tallow and low smoke, and he goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap — the clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the face at the yard's edge on three places with a finger between every pair; the first man's face, the second man's slate and direction and the well-asking on places of their own with a finger between every pair, no name, owner, answer carried, witness, sale, tenth hand or rule under any of them, a reaching gathering interest toward the far-off calling and not the calling itself; the fifth shaping on its own tray between Hessa's eighth hand and the road saying with a third finger between it and the four ownerless directions; Tarn's withheld sentence found where put and not made a habit; the softening at the river's skin found where put and not made a sign; Berr's low saying about kindness entered on a place of its own with his *your house* beside it and his belief left up the road with the box; the twelve old arithmetics behind one unsigned figure beside the first and second readings of the year — two readings two and not one account, the first not made a thirteenth by the second, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of two; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside on its own ground; the heard bell in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's gap, the boards' four and four and a knot, or the two readings behind one unsigned figure beside the twelve, three counts in three places staying three, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood; nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, four rooms with the same gap and no Court room a fifth likeness; the carried fire's four pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and nineteen days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the fire and the man standing side by side without becoming one; the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T080/T090/T102, T015/T041/T047, T078, T061/T082, T081, T088, T060/T086/T097). Answer **414** comes out and is filed on the sixth place: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the first and second of the new count, the printed figure, the fifth shaping, the clerk's entered figure, the well-asking, the second man's slate, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge, Jorra's ungiven promise, the withheld sentence, the softening, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the winter skin, the widow's mark nor the keeping at the fold. Six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 409 through 414, two to each of its three days, and not one is a doctrine. Count four hundred and nineteen exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-nine days, told by nobody who would have known what a number counted; the carried fire's fifth was unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number and the two counts stood side by side without becoming one. He did not stand four hundred and nineteen up as a threshold or a figure and borrowed no payer from the arithmetics gone up the road, for paper is not a payer. The surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side and neither buys the other; under them, louder, the wanting goes on: the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped, a hand on the handle of the pot. He wants the three things without knowing that wanting them is a want and gets none of them. Both are true. The second is louder. Neither won and no verdict was looked for; the quarrel was the work. A voice in a yard would be a voice in a yard and not a door; the asking given no name is still only an asking, and the well gave back the weather. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the note under the winter skin, the inch not a reach; he takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the covering — neither early nor stayed — and lets it go as the note ends, then comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. Four low pulls breathe below the floor with the fifth unsupplied. Nothing has been joined, named, called, paid or ended, and the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into a morning not yet earned and not brought into this one. Count four hundred and nineteen exact, and no number stood up as a threshold; Ilmen 30 (Day 424) stands five mornings beyond the close as a date and is not brought.
